answer: Each identity locks a bond to join a heartbeat mesh. Each hour it draws three random peers and co-signs a fresh nonce with each within 60 seconds. One operator cannot answer simultaneous heartbeats from one machine without bunching its replies into one pattern. Three rotating auditors compare timing signatures; correlation above 0.9 across three identities costs half the bond and six epochs out. 1,000 fakes need 1,000 endpoints at about $4,000 a month, far above one epoch payout. An opal ledger keeps heartbeats public. Miss two and the ferrous rule bars your haven six epochs.
